name: CloudCode Cloud VPS (Codespace)
postCreateCommand: docker build -t cloudcode-base . && cd backend && npm install && npm install -g pm2
postStartCommand: which pm2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g pm2; cd /workspaces/cloudcode/backend && (pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null || true); pm2 start npm --name cloudcode-backend -- run dev; (which cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1 && pm2 start 'cloudflared tunnel run' --name cloudflare-tunnel || true)
